text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Crown. Your run in that last race was 
truly vivace...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Viva... Ah! Thank you so much for the 
compliment♪ Calling my running spirited, 
that is."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Marcato! Ah, for a master of words such as 
yourself, it's only natural you saw right 
through my intentions!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand "clearly." Studying 
Italian is sure to come in handy someday, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Brava! Then let me declare here and now: 
Our next race will be Duramente!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If Duramente-san enters the race, it will 
surely be hers to take. Even so, I refuse 
to lose!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Whether it's against Earth-san or 
Duramente-san, I'm going to win! Be 
prepared for it!
